intelligence.human_view: He said: the numbers — the way they are — they could be more dynamic. They could be way higher level. Imagine we just made them epic, because they're going to be throughout our whole network, seen everywhere — so why don't we do the best, the best for all of our buttons? So I'd like to scorecard our Intelligent Block and think: how can I make this now take it to another level, so no matter what they're pasting — text, a smart note, an image — it formats beautifully and it's extraordinary to feel and see and look at. The captain scored it 7: what's good is the format does the work, the unfold and the slideshow are one language, the boards light whole. What's holding it back: the numbers sit still — they're pictures of numbers, not living numbers — the buttons are good but not the best, and pasted content still shows its seams. The next level: the numbers become epic and dynamic — living tiles that respond, glow, and move — the buttons become the best in the network, and the format gets so strong that anything pasted in comes out beautiful and extraordinary to feel, see, and look at.
